summary: Silvercorp Metals filed a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a Canadian foreign-private-issuer report, furnishing an explanatory note and blackline of proposed amendments to its Articles ahead of an annual and special meeting of shareholders on October 2, 2026. The special resolution would, if passed by at least two-thirds of votes cast, modify the Advance Notice Provisions, including a change to Article 16, paragraph 4 narrowing the additional information a nominating shareholder must supply. Amendments take effect immediately after the meeting upon approval. No take-over, activist, or capital-markets transaction is involved; a routine governance-resolution filing classified as None.
